==Biography==
Tore got into League of Legends after he got banned in Heroes of Newerth, since he had to find a new game to play with his brothers. He started maining support when Thresh came out and just fell in love with the champion, therefore maining support.

== Trivia ==
* Favourite food and drinks are pizza and Cola.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?time_continue=42&v=j2IMlZF51Tg ESPORTS ROCSTARS | Episode 3: Norskeren]youtube.com</ref>
* Favourite champion is {{ci|Thresh}}.
* Favourite music genres are Norwegian rap and K-Pop.
* Has 3 elder brothers.
** Is the only ginger between his siblings.
* Spent a lot of time playing [[wikipedia:en:Pok%C3%A9mon_(video_game_series)|Pokémon]] when he was young.
* Was banned in [[wikipedia:en:Heroes_of_Newerth|Heroes of Newerth]] because he would always leave in the middle of ranked games to eat dinner.
* Used to play all 5 roles in solo queue before he reached Diamond. Switched to play primarily support because he considers it easier to climb the rank ladder.
* Started playing League in 2011.
** First reached Challenger rank when he was 14 years old.
** Was a huge fan of [[Froggen]], [[Hotshotgg]], [[Chaox]], and [[Doublelift]] when he just started playing League.
* Always hovers {{ci|Volibear}} and {{ci|Warwick}} in champion select, just like [[Stixxay]]. 
* Reached 1000 assists in the LEC on March 13, 2021.
